title: Europe: classical to early modern
goal: Show major European events across four historical eras, including BCE and CE dates.

rubric.must: Classical Antiquity, Early Middle Ages, High and Late Middle Ages, and Early Modern Era are visibly labelled sections.
The timeline visibly spans BCE and CE events, beginning with the Roman Republic and continuing to Westphalia.
The picture shows multiple distinct dated historical events within the eras.
Roman Republic, fall of Rome, Norman Conquest, Constantinople, and Westphalia are visually emphasized milestones.
The Black Death is visibly shown as a multi-year range rather than a single point.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/timeline/swimlane/ideal.svg (7c3470ea58a6); rendered and visually reviewed. Exemplar swimlane palette and proportional calendar. Point events are not converted to invented work spans; crowded dates use extra rows within the same track. Milestones and declared ranges remain distinct.
